title: FloodConnect M8 household declaration
description: Caller-declared inputs for the home-as-shelter decision (P-C, advice/home_shelter.py:household_to_node -- not implemented in P-B). These are DECLARED inputs, never computed from a canal reading (invariant 9: water_vs_house_floor is the household's own observation, not derived from a station's h value -- that would fabricate a house depth). Field names reuse shelter_decision.py's existing vocabulary (member_need_profile, supplies) rather than inventing parallel ones. A test household used in automated tests must be labelled as a test household, never presented as a real person.

water_vs_house_floor.description: Household's own observation -- never computed from a canal/station reading (invariant 9).

member_need_profile.description: Reuses shelter_decision.py's VULNERABILITY_COUNT_FIELDS / FUNCTIONAL_NEED_COUNT_FIELDS names verbatim (e.g. bedbound_or_homebound, older_adult_60_plus, child_0_5, needs_power_dependent_medical_device, needs_time_critical_medical_followup, needs_infant_feeding) -- not re-specified here to avoid a second, divergent field list; see that module for the authoritative set.

supplies.description: Per-field days of supply; assessed_horizon_h = days * 24 (advice/home_shelter.py).

planning_horizon_h.description: From a cited official_guidance item if one exists, else declared by the household, else null/UNKNOWN -- never invented.

official_instruction.description: An official EVACUATE always wins over every colour/household input (P-C rule 1). WARNING (added, earlier pass -- per prd.go.th/534015's own 'evacuate immediately, do not wait for crisis level, on an official warning signal') is folded into the same rule-1 outcome as EVACUATE: the household must follow whatever the official instruction actually says, never treated as merely NONE.

declared_now.description: When this declaration was made -- used for dry_status_fresh in the home Dry Gate.

animal_profile.description: Optional -- reuses human_animal_household.py's evaluate_animal_unit input shape. For the SUSTAINMENT/Dry-Gate calculation itself, an absent profile still defaults to zero animal burden (unchanged). FIX5B (founder ruling 2026-10-06): for the home-shelter verdict's own confidence, a wholly absent profile (null/key omitted) is now treated as MISSING information, not as 'no animals' -- it lowers confidence with a named reason (advice/home_shelter.py). An EXPLICIT declaration of no animals (`{}`, or any profile whose declared_animal_count is 0) is real information and does NOT lower confidence.

test_household.description: True only in automated tests -- a declared input used in a test must be marked so it is never mistaken for a real household's data.
